infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: ket connects to your Mac over your Wi-Fi to show and control the agents running on it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ket uses the microphone when you tap the mic in a chat, to write what you say into your message.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: ket turns what you say into the words of your message, on this iPhone wherever it can.

plugins.faceIDPermission: ket uses Face ID to unlock the app, so only you can reach your desktops' terminals from this phone.

plugins.cameraPermission: ket uses the camera to scan the pairing code your Mac shows, and to take photos you send to an agent.
